gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.flouris:
Summer blooms in splendor,
swaying like waves.
The traveler opens their arms;
scent fills their sleeves.

At witching dusk,
fireflies rise.
Insect song floods all.
The traveler, a little tired,
sinks into earthbound stars.

Shreds of sunlight fall.
The traveler lifts a hand:
a gaze flashes between fingers.
Grass swells; flowers blaze.

“How quiet…”
Amid the ceaseless rustle,
the traveler speaks.
He quickens his pace.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.abyss.w:
Where wind and water end,
dawn and dusk hang as one.
Stand here. Speak your heart.
The waves will answer.

The sea is time's expanse,
a dream, a fleeting foam.
Reflected moonlight
rushes to the traveler.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.abyss.m:
O blue as deep as starlit skies,
vast, kind, solemn, fathomless.

The stars align.
The traveler hears
a whisper kin to blood.
Fall, fall, fall…

All things spring from the sea.
Return, then, to the womb.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.far_rea:
Sunset spills gold.
The sky shines clear.
“I come from far away…”

Sun blazes on fields of gold;
all things burn bright.
Here, legends set forth.

The traveler walks among them,
through the self's wasteland.

We are wayfarers in time;
by chance, our moments cross.

Wind and rain fill the ear.
Ahead, a lightless night.
So we walk with fire;
its flicker lights a corner.

The wilds stretch on.
Alone, we cross the waste.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.deep_va:
The traveler takes the valley path,
looks up from the depths:
mist, moss, threads of silk—
an unreachable sky in each.

The murmurs have fallen still.
A tale no one knows
softly blooms in a pool.
Something undefiled
drifts slowly down the stream.

Sun above, moonshade below.
The valley floor sways—
a cradle left behind.

Come, come, a little lower.
The voices will draw near.
The names will be the same.

This shore or the other world—
do you belong here, too?
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.underwo:
Last night,
someone buried a raven.
The traveler bent low,
and lingered long.

Wind brushed its old name,
bore all softly away.
Never to return, never to return.

The underworld road descends.
White Death smiles at its end.

Below, fell fires burn on;
ash climbs the mortal world.

Who calls? Who answers?
Bloodlight floods charred earth.
Lava flows slow.

The traveler treads a burning pulse,
and storms into the gateless realm.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.boundle:
Ordinary days lie far behind.
The once-fallen sky
blooms slowly in the void.

Darkness twines like vines,
holds each step, guides the way.
Beyond that door, the traveler
is singular in an empty world.

Dream walks within dream;
sky hangs beyond sky.
The end, the end—
a little farther still.

The traveler records
the chaos of the void,
writes of the formless.
Wilds float amid the stars,
asleep in vast silence.
